name: TextBox 2
text: The dataset contains 1,341 NORMAL and 3,875 PNEUMONIA training images. Most files are grayscale, with 283 RGB files. Thirty exact duplicate groups exist within individual splits, while no exact duplicate group crosses train, validation, or test boundaries. The supplied validation set is too small for dependable model selection, so the pipeline creates a seeded internal validation split and keeps duplicate images together.
